title: More reliable autonomous runs
highlights: Todo completion synonyms such as done and finished no longer trigger false auto-poke loops
Grok Build is available as an ACP provider
improvements: Todo status values are documented and constrained in the tool schema
Desktop and SDK clients expose provider request lifecycle status
fixes: Todo statuses are normalized on write and compared case-insensitively during headless run completion checks
Codex quota windows no longer appear more than once
Pinned todo configuration tests no longer leak process-global configuration
